d:
Lok aastha ka mahaparv chhath char dinon tak chalne vali kathin sadhna, aastha, sanyam aur prakriti ke prati kritagyata ka parv hai. nahay-khay se shuru hone vala yah mahaparv kharna, sandhya arghy aur phir ugte sury ko pratkalin arghy dene ke sath sanpann ho jata hai. chhath ke chauthe din vrati kuchh der bad hi udiyman sury ko arghy arpit karengi, iske sath hi 36 ghante ka nirjala upvas khatm ho jaega. isi ke sath chhathi maeeya aur sury dev ki aaradhna ka char divsiy anushthan pura hoga.
